fix_commit_message:
Bug 1992130 - Fix arguments types for std::copy. r=rhunt

Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D267284
agent_reasoning: The intro commit added StableWasmArrayObjectElements with a std::copy call mixing a byte-typed source range (uint8_t* with byte-count length via inlineStorage()) against a T-typed destination iterator, causing a buffer overflow of sizeof(T)x for the heap-allocated Vector, and also used the wrong source offset (start of inline storage/header instead of the array data after the header). The fix adds a typed inlineArrayElements<T>() accessor that points past the DataHeader and rewrites the std::copy call to use matching T* iterators and a correct element count. I applied the same edits directly to WasmGcObject.h.
